title: MOXIR — the stage on the owner's line, the cut FLIPPED as a backdrop behind the DJ (picture gate, scratch only)
status: PICTURE GATE for the owner's look (2026-10-07): built on the scratch stack only, as a separate project beside moxir-known-full-stage24 (which is unchanged). Not a decision.
owner: 2026-10-07, his own marks on video frame 954 @ 3.6 s (~/Downloads/moxir/,dob fixed last places bags-from-video-954.jpg): a green STAGE LINE across the floor at the front of the white bags, the DJ (teal) behind it, speakers (blue) L and R on it, the audience (orange) everything in front, toward the entry. Earlier the same day: "we can move the crane". His order: stage → crane place → truss → lights. Later the same day: "keep max dj center and we dont need to 2n floor stage for dj just one step thing" — the booth on the nave axis, one low step instead of the 1.2 m riser. Picture gate, later 2026-10-07: "maybe we will flip the truss? … the truss at the back of the DJ — where the DJ stage line finishes, the crane line there — with the truss flipped. I want to see that."

deck.why_three: "one step" read as one LEVEL, not one 2 × 1 m deck: a single deck leaves 0.2 m behind the 0.8 m deep DJ table for the DJ to stand — the 3 × 2 m base footprint is kept (owner to confirm)

booth.table_note: the DJ table stays 0.95 m high on the step (top 1.15 m from the floor) — moxir-2026-10-17.json stage.table

moved.why: the roller conveyor the owner marked beside the bags (hall v8, massing roller-conveyor: x 3.6–4.6, z 16.5–24.0, top 0.85 m, ±1 m x / ±2.5 m z) runs under the riser as drawn: centred on his mark (x 0.945–3.945, z 22.5–24.5) the riser overlaps it by 0.345 m in x and 1.5 m in z. The least move that clears it: 0.345 m toward house left to touch, + 0.1 m clear (a deck needs its legs and edge free of a fixed machine) = 0.445 m, riser x 0.5–3.5. Still inside his mark's ±0.7 m accuracy. Moving it toward the audience instead would put the front 1.5 m past his line; shrinking it to two decks would change the booth.
moved.question_for_owner: The conveyor's end reaches the booth as you drew it. I moved the booth 0.45 m to house left (centre x 2.0 instead of 2.45) so it stands clear. OK, or should the conveyor's end be cleared / the booth be 2 decks wide? (The conveyor's place is ±1 m: tape it on 10-08.)
